# SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Supply Agreement (this "**Agreement**") is entered into as of March 1, 2025 (the "**Effective Date**" or "**Supply Agreement Effective Date**") between:

**Ziteir Aerial Robotics, Inc.**, a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 4410 Sorrel Ridge Parkway, Wilmington, Delaware 19803 ("**Ziteir**" or "**Supplier**"); and

**Lakix Grower Services, LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company with its principal place of business at 1275 Harvest Mill Road, Dover, Delaware 19901 ("**Lakix**" or "**Customer**").

Ziteir and Lakix are each a "**Party**" and together the "**Parties**."

## RECITALS

A. Ziteir designs and manufactures autonomous agricultural spray drones. It also operates a cloud-based fleet telemetry platform and provides related deployment and training services.

B. Lakix provides agronomy and application services to growers. It wishes to buy drones and subscribe to the telemetry platform for use in those services, and to engage Ziteir for deployment and training services.

C. The Parties wish to set out the terms on which Ziteir will supply, and Lakix will buy, those Products and Services.

The Parties therefore agree as follows:

## 1. DEFINITIONS

In this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings below:

1.1 "**Affiliate**" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a Party, where "control" means ownership of more than 50% of the voting equity of an entity.

1.2 "**Data Processing Addendum**" or "**DPA**" means the Data Processing Addendum between the Parties dated as of the Effective Date. The DPA governs Ziteir's processing of Grower Data, as amended from time to time.

1.3 "**Documentation**" means Ziteir's published operator manuals, technical specifications and maintenance guides for the Products.

1.4 "**Drones**" means the ZX-40 autonomous crop-spraying drones described in Exhibit A, including the standard accessories listed there.

1.5 "**Grower Data**" has the meaning given in the DPA.

1.6 "**Initial Term**" has the meaning given in Section 2.1.

1.7 "**Platform**" means Ziteir's ZiteirLink fleet telemetry platform, including its web and mobile interfaces, application programming interfaces and related hosted services described in Exhibit A.

1.8 "**Products**" means the Drones, Spare Parts and Platform subscriptions listed in Exhibit A, as updated by the Parties in writing.

1.9 "**Purchase Order**" means a written order for Products that Lakix issues under this Agreement and that Ziteir accepts in accordance with Section 3.

1.10 "**Renewal Term**" has the meaning given in Section 2.2.

1.11 "**Services**" means the fleet deployment, commissioning, pilot training and related professional services described in a Statement of Work.

1.12 "**Spare Parts**" means the replacement components for the Drones listed in Exhibit A.

1.13 "**Statement of Work**" or "**SOW**" means a statement of work for Services that both Parties sign and that references this Agreement, including Statement of Work No. 001 (Fleet Deployment and Pilot Training).

1.14 "**Term**" means the Initial Term together with all Renewal Terms.

## 2. TERM

2.1 **Initial Term.** This Agreement begins on the Effective Date. It continues for an initial term of two years from the Supply Agreement Effective Date, ending February 28, 2027 (the "**Initial Term**"), unless terminated earlier under Section 14.

2.2 **Renewal.** At the end of the Initial Term, this Agreement will renew automatically for successive three-year renewal terms (each a "**Renewal Term**"). Either Party may prevent renewal by giving the other Party written notice of non-renewal at least 30 days before the end of the then-current term.

## 3. ORDERS

3.1 **Purchase Orders.** Lakix will order Products by issuing Purchase Orders to Ziteir. Each Purchase Order will state the Products and quantities, the requested delivery dates and the delivery location.

3.2 **Acceptance.** Ziteir will accept or reject each Purchase Order in writing within five business days after receipt. If Ziteir does not respond within that period, the Purchase Order is deemed accepted. Ziteir will not unreasonably reject a Purchase Order that is consistent with the forecast provided under Section 3.3.

3.3 **Forecasts.** By the first day of each calendar quarter, Lakix will give Ziteir a non-binding rolling forecast of its anticipated Drone requirements for the following two quarters.

3.4 **Conflicting Terms.** Any pre-printed or additional terms in a Purchase Order, acknowledgment or invoice have no effect.

## 4. PRICING AND PAYMENT

4.1 **Prices.** Lakix will pay the prices for Products set out in Exhibit B. Fees for Services are as set out in the applicable Statement of Work.

4.2 **Fixed Pricing.** The prices set out in Exhibit B are fixed for the duration of the Term.

4.3 **Invoicing.** Ziteir will invoice Drones and Spare Parts upon shipment. Platform subscription fees are invoiced annually in advance from the activation date of each Drone on the Platform.

4.4 **Payment.** Undisputed invoices are due within 30 days of receipt, in U.S. dollars, by wire transfer to the account Ziteir designates. Lakix will notify Ziteir in writing of any good-faith dispute within 15 days of receipt of the invoice, and the Parties will work to resolve it promptly. Late undisputed amounts bear interest at 1% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower.

4.5 **Taxes.** Prices exclude sales, use, value-added and similar taxes. Lakix is responsible for those taxes, other than taxes based on Ziteir's net income.

## 5. DELIVERY, TITLE AND RISK

5.1 **Delivery.** Ziteir will deliver Products FCA Ziteir's facility in Wilmington, Delaware (Incoterms 2020), unless a Purchase Order specifies a different delivery location that Ziteir accepts.

5.2 **Title and Risk.** Title to and risk of loss of Drones and Spare Parts pass to Lakix upon delivery. Title

to the Platform and all software embedded in the Drones remains with Ziteir and is licensed under Section 7.

5.3 **Late Delivery.** Ziteir will notify Lakix promptly of any expected delay in delivery. If Ziteir delivers any Drone more than 30 days after the delivery date confirmed for it, Lakix may cancel the affected portion of the Purchase Order without liability.

## 6. INSPECTION AND ACCEPTANCE

6.1 Lakix will inspect Drones within ten business days after delivery. Lakix may reject any Drone that does not materially conform to the specifications in Exhibit A by giving written notice that describes the nonconformity.

6.2 Ziteir will repair or replace any rejected Drone at its cost within 20 business days after receipt of a rejection notice. Drones not rejected within the inspection period are deemed accepted, without prejudice to Lakix's rights under Section 9.

## 7. PLATFORM AND SOFTWARE

7.1 **Platform Access.** Subject to payment of the applicable fees, Ziteir grants Lakix a non-exclusive, non-transferable right during the Term to access and use the Platform for each subscribed Drone, solely for Lakix's operations and services to its grower clients.

7.2 **Embedded Software.** Ziteir grants Lakix a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the firmware and software embedded in each Drone solely to operate that Drone. The license continues for as long as Lakix or its permitted transferee owns the Drone.

7.3 **Restrictions.** Lakix will not reverse engineer, decompile or modify the Platform or embedded software, except to the extent applicable law permits despite this restriction.

7.4 **Availability.** Ziteir will make the Platform available in accordance with the service levels set out in Exhibit A.

## 8. SERVICES; DATA PROTECTION

8.1 **Services.** Ziteir will perform the Services described in each Statement of Work in a professional and workmanlike manner, using appropriately qualified personnel.

8.2 **Data Protection.** Each Party will comply with the Data Processing Addendum in connection with the processing of Grower Data through the Platform and the Drones.

## 9. WARRANTIES

9.1 **Product Warranty.** Ziteir warrants that each Drone and Spare Part will be free from material defects in materials and workmanship. Ziteir also warrants that each will conform in all material respects to the specifications in Exhibit A and the Documentation for 12 months after delivery.

9.2 **Remedy.** If a Drone or Spare Part breaches Section 9.1, Ziteir will repair or replace it, at its option and expense, within 15 business days after notice. If Ziteir cannot repair or replace it, Ziteir will refund the price paid for it.

9.3 **Platform Warranty.** Ziteir warrants that the Platform will perform materially in accordance with the Documentation during the Term.

9.4 **Exclusions.** The warranties in this Section 9 do not apply to defects caused by misuse, accident, unauthorized modification, failure to follow the Documentation, or use of chemicals or payloads outside the specifications in Exhibit A.

9.5 **Compliance.** Each Party will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. This includes, in the case of Lakix, Federal Aviation Administration regulations governing the operation of unmanned aircraft and applicable pesticide application laws.

9.6 **Disclaimer.** EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS AGREEMENT, ZITEIR MAKES NO OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED. THIS INCLUDES ANY IMPLIED WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

## 10. INDEMNIFICATION

10.1 **By Ziteir.** Ziteir will defend Lakix and its Affiliates against any third-party claim alleging that the Products infringe or misappropriate a U.S. patent, copyright, trademark or trade secret. Ziteir will indemnify them against resulting damages and costs finally awarded or agreed in settlement.

10.2 **By Lakix.** Lakix will defend Ziteir and its Affiliates against any third-party claim arising from Lakix's operation of the Drones in breach of applicable law, or from Lakix's selection or application of chemicals. Lakix will indemnify them against resulting damages and costs finally awarded or agreed in settlement.

10.3 **Procedure.** The indemnified Party will:

(a) give prompt written notice of the claim;

(b) give the indemnifying Party sole control of the defense and settlement; and

(c) provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense.

The indemnifying Party may not settle a claim in a way that imposes any obligation on the indemnified Party without that Party's consent.

## 11. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

11.1 **Cap.** Except for liability under Section 11.3, each Party's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid by Lakix in the 12 months preceding the claim.

11.2 **Exclusion of Indirect Damages.** Except for liability under Section 11.3, neither Party is liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, special or punitive damages, or for lost profits or crop loss, even if it was advised of their possibility.

11.3 **Exceptions.** Sections 11.1 and 11.2 do not apply to:

(a) Lakix's payment obligations;

(b) a Party's fraud, gross negligence or willful misconduct; or

(c) a Party's obligations under Section 10.

## 12. CONFIDENTIALITY

12.1 Each Party will keep confidential all non-public information the other Party discloses that is marked or reasonably understood to be confidential ("**Confidential Information**"). It will use that Confidential Information only to perform under this Agreement.

12.2 These obligations do not apply to information that:

(a) is or becomes public through no fault of the receiving Party;

(b) was already known to the receiving Party without restriction;

(c) is independently developed; or

(d) is rightfully received from a third party without restriction.

12.3 A Party may disclose Confidential Information if required by law, after giving the other Party prompt notice

 where lawful. These obligations survive for three years after the end of the Term, and indefinitely for trade secrets.

## 13. INSURANCE

During the Term, Ziteir will maintain the following insurance with reputable insurers:

(a) commercial general liability insurance, including products liability, of at least $5,000,000 per occurrence;

(b) aviation liability insurance covering the Drones while Ziteir personnel operate them, of at least $5,000,000 per occurrence; and

(c) cyber liability insurance of at least $3,000,000.

Ziteir will provide certificates of insurance upon request.

## 14. TERMINATION

14.1 **For Cause.** Either Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other Party materially breaches it and does not cure the breach within 30 days after receiving written notice describing it.

14.2 **Insolvency.** Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the other Party:

(a) becomes insolvent;

(b) makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors;

(c) has a receiver appointed; or

(d) becomes subject to bankruptcy proceedings that are not dismissed within 60 days.

14.3 **Effect.** On expiration or termination:

(a) Ziteir will fulfill accepted Purchase Orders unless Lakix cancels them;

(b) Lakix will pay all amounts due for Products delivered and Services performed;

(c) Platform access will end, subject to the data return provisions of the DPA; and

(d) Sections 5.2, 7.2, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14.3 and 18 survive.

## 15. ASSIGNMENT

15.1 **General.** Neither Party may assign or transfer this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the other Party's prior written consent. Any purported assignment without that consent is void.

15.2 **Change of Control.** Any change of control of Supplier, including a merger, consolidation, sale of equity or other transaction in which more than 50% of Supplier's voting equity changes hands, is deemed an assignment of this Agreement. Any such assignment requires Lakix's prior written consent. Failure to obtain that consent is a material breach of this Agreement and entitles Lakix to terminate this Agreement by written notice and to recover its damages.

15.3 **Binding Effect.** This Agreement binds and benefits the Parties and their permitted successors and assigns.

## 16. FORCE MAJEURE

16.1 Neither Party is liable for any failure or delay in performance, other than payment obligations, caused by events beyond its reasonable control. Such events include acts of God, severe weather, epidemic, war, terrorism, governmental action, airspace restrictions and failures of public utilities or telecommunications networks.

16.2 The affected Party will notify the other Party promptly and use reasonable efforts to resume performance. If a force majeure event continues for more than 90 days, either Party may terminate the affected Purchase Order or Statement of Work by written notice.

## 17. NOTICES

17.1 Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by email with confirmation sent by courier. Notices are sent to the addresses below, or to such other address as a Party designates by notice:

**To Ziteir:** Ziteir Aerial Robotics, Inc., 4410 Sorrel Ridge Parkway, Wilmington, Delaware 19803, Attention: General Counsel; legal@ziteir.com

**To Lakix:** Lakix Grower Services, LLC, 1275 Harvest Mill Road, Dover, Delaware 19901, Attention: Chief Operating Officer; contracts@lakixgrowers.com

17.2 Notices are effective upon receipt.

## 18. GENERAL

18.1 **Governing Law.** This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or relating to it are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

18.2 **Forum.** Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware, for any action arising out of or relating to this Agreement. Each Party waives any objection to venue in those courts.

18.3 **Order of Precedence.** If there is a conflict among the documents forming the Parties' agreement, the following order of precedence applies: Data Processing Addendum, then Statement of Work, then Supply Agreement.

18.4 **Amendment and Waiver.** This Agreement may be amended only by a written instrument signed by both Parties. No waiver is effective unless it is in writing. A failure or delay in exercising any right is not a waiver of it.

18.5 **Independent Contractors.** The Parties are independent contractors. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture or agency relationship.

18.6 **Severability.** If any provision of this Agreement is held unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in full force. The unenforceable provision will be reformed to the minimum extent necessary to make it enforceable.

18.7 **Counterparts.** This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature. Each counterpart is an original, and together they form one instrument.

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

# DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM

This Data Processing Addendum (this "**DPA**") is entered into as of March 1, 2025 (the "**DPA Effective Date**") between:

**Ziteir Aerial Robotics, Inc.**, a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 4410 Sorrel Ridge Parkway, Wilmington, Delaware 19803 ("**Ziteir**" or "**Processor**"); and

**Lakix Grower Services, LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company with its principal place of business at 1275 Harvest Mill Road, Dover, Delaware 19901 ("**Lakix**" or "**Controller**").

Ziteir and Lakix are each a "**Party**" and together the "**Parties**."

## RECITALS

A. The Parties have entered into a Supply Agreement dated as of March 1, 2025 (the "**Agreement**"). Under the Agreement, Ziteir supplies ZX-40 autonomous crop-spraying drones, the ZiteirLink fleet telemetry platform and related Services to Lakix.

B. In providing the Platform, the Drones and the Services, Ziteir will collect, host and otherwise process Grower Data on behalf of Lakix and its grower clients.

C. Section 8.2 of the Agreement requires each Party to comply with this DPA in connection with the processing of Grower Data through the Platform and the Drones.

The Parties therefore agree as follows:

## 1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 Capitalized terms used but not defined in this DPA have the meanings given in the Agreement.

1.2 "**Applicable Data Protection Law**" means all laws and regulations of the United States and its states that apply to the processing of Grower Data under the Agreement. This includes, where applicable, the Delaware Personal Data Privacy Act, the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act, and state data breach notification laws.

1.3 "**Grower**" means any farm operator, landowner or other client of Lakix for whom Lakix provides agronomy or application services using the Drones or the Platform.

1.4 "**Grower Data**" means all data and information that Lakix, a Grower, or any Drone operated by or for Lakix submits to, generates within, or uploads to the Platform or the Drones. Grower Data includes:

(a) field boundaries, prescription maps, yield and soil data, and crop and agronomic records;

(b) flight logs, spray application logs, as-applied maps and chemical application records;

(c) geolocation data associated with Growers' fields and operations; and

(d) Personal Data of Growers and their personnel.

1.5 "**Personal Data**" means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, or that is otherwise defined as "personal data," "personal information" or a similar term under Applicable Data Protection Law.

1.6 "**Process**" or "**processing**" means any operation performed on Grower Data, whether or not by automated means. This includes collection, recording, storage, retrieval, use, disclosure, transmission, erasure and destruction.

1.7 "**Security Incident**" means any actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access to, or acquisition, use, disclosure, alteration, loss or destruction of, Grower Data while in the possession, custody or control of Processor or any Sub-processor.

1.8 "**Sub-processor**" means any third party that Processor engages to process Grower Data on its behalf.

## 2. ROLES AND SCOPE

2.1 **Roles.** As between the Parties, Lakix is the controller of Grower Data. Ziteir processes Grower Data solely as a processor or service provider on behalf of Lakix.

2.2 **Scope of Processing.** Processor will process Grower Data only as necessary to:

(a) provide, maintain and support the Platform and the Drones;

(b) perform the Services under any Statement of Work; and

(c) comply with Lakix's documented written instructions, including those given through the Platform's configuration settings.

2.3 **Details of Processing.** The subject matter, nature, purpose and categories of Grower Data are described in Annex 1. Processing will continue for the Term and for any data return period under Section 9.

2.4 **Lakix Responsibilities.** Lakix is responsible for obtaining any notices, consents and authorizations from Growers that Applicable Data Protection Law requires for Processor to process Grower Data under this DPA.

## 3. PROCESSOR OBLIGATIONS

3.1 **Instructions.** Processor will process Grower Data only on Lakix's documented instructions, unless applicable law requires otherwise. Processor will promptly inform Lakix if, in its reasonable opinion, an instruction violates Applicable Data Protection Law.

3.2 **Restrictions.** Processor will not:

(a) sell or share Grower Data, as those terms are defined under Applicable Data Protection Law;

(b) retain, use or disclose Grower Data for any purpose other than the purposes in Section 2.2;

(c) combine Grower Data with data Processor receives from other customers, except as permitted under Section 3.3; or

(d) use Grower Data to market products or services to any Grower.

3.3 **Aggregated Data.** Processor may create aggregated and de-identified data from Grower Data to operate, secure and improve the Platform and the Drones. Processor will ensure that such data cannot reasonably be used to identify Lakix, any Grower, any individual or any specific field location, and will not attempt to re-identify it.

3.4 **Personnel.** Processor will ensure that each person it authorizes to process Grower Data is bound by appropriate confidentiality obligations and receives appropriate training in data protection.

3.5 **Compliance.** Processor will comply with the obligations that Applicable Data Protection Law imposes on processors and service providers.

## 4. SECURITY

4.1 **Security Measures.** Processor will implement and maintain appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect Grower Data against Security Incidents. These measures include, at a minimum, the measures described in Annex 2.

4.2 **Review.** Processor will review its security measures at least annually and update them as reasonably necessary to address evolving

ziteir_lakix_data_processing_addendum.md, page 2 of 3:
threats. Processor will not materially reduce the overall level of protection those measures provide during the Term.

## 5. SUB-PROCESSORS

5.1 **Authorization.** Lakix generally authorizes Processor to engage Sub-processors. The Sub-processors engaged as of the DPA Effective Date are listed in Annex 3.

5.2 **Notice of New Sub-processors.** Processor will give Lakix at least 30 days' written notice before engaging a new Sub-processor. Lakix may object on reasonable data protection grounds within 15 days after that notice. If Lakix objects, the Parties will discuss the objection in good faith. If they cannot resolve it within 30 days, Lakix may terminate the affected Platform subscriptions without penalty.

5.3 **Sub-processor Terms.** Processor will impose on each Sub-processor written data protection obligations no less protective of Grower Data than those in this DPA. Processor remains responsible for each Sub-processor's performance of those obligations.

## 6. SECURITY INCIDENTS

6.1 **Notification.** Processor will notify Lakix without undue delay, and in any event within 72 hours, after becoming aware of a Security Incident.

6.2 **Content of Notice.** The notice will describe, to the extent then known:

(a) the nature of the Security Incident;

(b) the categories and approximate volume of Grower Data affected;

(c) the Growers likely to be affected; and

(d) the measures Processor has taken or proposes to take to contain and remediate it.

Processor will supplement the notice as further information becomes available.

6.3 **Cooperation.** Processor will take reasonable steps to contain, investigate and remediate each Security Incident. Processor will cooperate with Lakix in meeting any obligation to notify Growers, individuals or regulators.

6.4 **Public Statements.** Processor will not notify any Grower or make any public statement about a Security Incident that identifies Lakix or any Grower without Lakix's prior written approval, unless applicable law requires it.

## 7. ASSISTANCE AND AUDIT

7.1 **Data Subject Requests.** Processor will promptly forward to Lakix any request it receives from a Grower or individual relating to Grower Data. Processor will provide reasonable assistance to enable Lakix to respond to such requests.

7.2 **Assessments.** Processor will provide reasonable information and assistance to enable Lakix to carry out any data protection assessment that Applicable Data Protection Law requires in connection with the Platform.

7.3 **Audit.** Once in any 12-month period, Lakix may request that Processor provide its most recent independent third-party security assessment or certification report covering the Platform. If that report does not reasonably address Lakix's concerns, Lakix may, on at least 30 days' written notice, conduct an audit of Processor's relevant processing activities. Any such audit will take place during normal business hours, will be subject to Processor's reasonable confidentiality and security requirements, and will be at Lakix's expense.

## 8. INDEMNIFICATION

8.1 **Data Incident Indemnity.** Processor will defend, indemnify and hold harmless Lakix, its Affiliates and each Grower from and against all losses, damages, liabilities, fines, penalties, costs and expenses arising out of or relating to any Security Incident involving Grower Data. These include:

(a) regulatory fines and penalties;

(b) the costs of notifying affected Growers, individuals and regulators;

(c) credit monitoring, call center and forensic investigation costs; and

(d) amounts payable in respect of third-party claims, including reasonable attorneys' fees.

8.2 **Scope of Indemnity.** Processor's obligations under Section 8.1 apply to each Security Incident, whether or not caused by Processor's fault, and shall not be subject to any limitation of liability in the Agreement.

8.3 **Procedure.** The procedure in Section 10.3 of the Agreement applies to claims for indemnification under this Section 8.

## 9. RETURN AND DELETION OF GROWER DATA

9.1 **Export During the Term.** Lakix may export Grower Data at any time during the Term through the Platform's export functions and application programming interfaces.

9.2 **Return on Expiration or Termination.** For 60 days after expiration or termination of the Agreement, Processor will continue to make Grower Data available to Lakix for export. On Lakix's written request during that period, Processor will deliver Grower Data to Lakix in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

9.3 **Deletion.** Within 30 days after the end of the export period in Section 9.2, Processor will delete all Grower Data in its possession or control and will certify the deletion in writing on request. Processor may retain Grower Data to the extent applicable law requires, provided that it keeps that data confidential and processes it only for the purpose of that legal requirement.

## 10. TERM; GENERAL

10.1 **Term.** This DPA takes effect on the DPA Effective Date and continues for as long as Processor processes Grower Data under the Agreement.

10.2 **Survival.** Sections 6, 8 and 9 survive expiration or termination of the Agreement for as long as Processor or any Sub-processor retains any Grower Data, and Section 8 survives as to any Security Incident occurring before that time.

10.3 **Agreement Provisions.** Sections 17 (Notices) and 18.1 (Governing Law) and 18.2 (Forum) of the Agreement apply to this DPA as if set out in full.

10.4 **Amendment.** This DPA may be amended only by a written instrument signed by both Parties.

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have executed this DPA as of the DPA Effective Date.

## ANNEX 2: SECURITY MEASURES

1. Encryption of Grower Data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher, and at rest using AES-256.
2. Role-based access controls, multi-factor authentication for administrative access, and quarterly access reviews.
3. Logical separation of each customer's Grower Data within the Platform.
4. Continuous logging and monitoring of Platform infrastructure, with alerting for anomalous activity.
5. Annual third-party penetration testing of the Platform and remediation of critical findings within 30 days.
6. Secure, signed firmware updates for the Drones and encrypted data links between Drones and the Platform.
7. Daily encrypted backups stored in a geographically separate region, with tested restoration procedures.
8. A documented incident response plan, tested at least annually.
9. Background checks for personnel with access to Grower Data, to the extent permitted by law.

# STATEMENT OF WORK NO. 001

## FLEET DEPLOYMENT AND PILOT TRAINING

This Statement of Work No. 001 (this "**SOW**") is entered into as of March 1, 2025 (the "**SOW Effective Date**") between **Ziteir Aerial Robotics, Inc.**, a Delaware corporation ("**Ziteir**" or "**Supplier**"), and **Lakix Grower Services, LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company ("**Lakix**" or "**Customer**"). Ziteir and Lakix are each a "**Party**" and together the "**Parties**."

This SOW is issued under the Supply Agreement between the Parties dated as of March 1, 2025 (the "**Agreement**"). Capitalized terms used but not defined in this SOW have the meanings given in the Agreement.

## 1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE

1.1 **Purpose.** Lakix intends to deploy a fleet of ZX-40 Drones across its operating bases. It will use the fleet to provide crop-spraying and application services to Growers. Under this SOW, Ziteir will commission those Drones, integrate them with the ZiteirLink Platform, and train Lakix's pilots and fleet technicians (together, the "**Services**").

1.2 **Fleet.** The Parties anticipate deployment of up to 24 Drones in the phases described in Section 3. Lakix will buy Drones, Spare Parts and Platform subscriptions separately by Purchase Orders under Section 3 of the Agreement. They are priced under Exhibit B to the Agreement. This SOW does not itself obligate Lakix to purchase any Products.

1.3 **Operating Bases.** The Services will be performed at the following Lakix operating bases (each a "**Site**"), and at any additional Site the Parties agree in writing:

(a) Dover Base, 1275 Harvest Mill Road, Dover, Delaware 19901;

(b) Georgetown Base, Sussex County, Delaware; and

(c) Easton Base, Talbot County, Maryland.

## 2. SERVICES

2.1 **Site Readiness Assessment.** Before each phase, Ziteir will visit each Site scheduled for that phase. During the visit Ziteir will assess:

(a) battery charging capacity;

(b) chemical mixing and loading areas;

(c) storage and maintenance facilities;

(d) cellular and RTK connectivity; and

(e) local airspace conditions.

Ziteir will deliver a written Site readiness report within ten business days after each visit, identifying any changes Lakix should make before commissioning.

2.2 **Commissioning.** For each Drone delivered under a Purchase Order, Ziteir will:

(a) unpack, assemble and inspect the Drone and its standard accessories;

(b) install current firmware and confirm the Drone's registration on the Platform;

(c) calibrate the spray system, flow meters and nozzles to the product labels Lakix supplies;

(d) set up and survey RTK base stations; and

(e) complete a test flight and test spray using water.

Commissioning does not replace Lakix's inspection rights under Section 6 of the Agreement.

2.3 **Platform Configuration.** Ziteir will configure Lakix's ZiteirLink account. This includes:

(a) user roles and permissions;

(b) import of Lakix's initial field boundaries and prescription map templates;

(c) maintenance alert thresholds; and

(d) export settings for Lakix's agronomy record systems.

Ziteir will process all Grower Data in connection with the Services in accordance with the Data Processing Addendum.

2.4 **Pilot Training.** Ziteir will deliver its ZX-40 Operator Course to Lakix pilots nominated by Lakix (each a "**Trainee**"). The course consists of:

(a) two days of classroom and simulator instruction covering flight planning, mission setup, emergency procedures, battery management and Platform use; and

(b) three days of supervised field flights at a Site.

Each training cohort will include no more than eight Trainees. Ziteir will issue a course completion certificate to each Trainee who passes the course's practical assessment.

2.5 **Technician Training.** Ziteir will deliver its ZX-40 Field Maintenance Course to Lakix technicians nominated by Lakix. The course covers routine maintenance, replacement of Spare Parts, nozzle and pump servicing, diagnostics and firmware updates. It runs for two days, with no more than six technicians per cohort.

2.6 **Season Support.** During each phase's spray season support window in Section 3, Ziteir will provide:

(a) a dedicated field support engineer available by phone and Platform chat from 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time, seven days a week; and

(b) on-site support at a Site within 24 hours of Lakix's request where an issue cannot be resolved remotely.

2.7 **Annual Refresher.** Before the start of the 2026 spray season, Ziteir will deliver a one-day refresher course for all certified Trainees. The course will cover firmware and Platform updates released since the original training.

## 3. PHASES AND SCHEDULE

| Phase | Sites | Anticipated Drones | Services Window | Season Support Window |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phase 1 | Dover Base | Up to 8 | March 15, 2025 to May 31, 2025 | April 1, 2025 to September 30, 2025 |
| Phase 2 | Georgetown Base and Easton Base | Up to 10 | January 15, 2026 to April 15, 2026 | April 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026 |
| Phase 3 | All Sites (fleet expansion) | Up to 6 | September 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027 | October 1, 2026 to November 30, 2026 (fall application season) |

3.1 **Scheduling.** The Parties will agree specific dates for Site visits, commissioning and training cohorts at least 15 business days in advance. Ziteir will use commercially reasonable efforts to complete commissioning of each Drone within ten business days after delivery under the applicable Purchase Order.

3.2 **Schedule Changes.** Either Party may request a change to the schedule by written notice to the other Party's Project Manager. Where Lakix requests a change less than five business days before a scheduled on-site visit, Lakix will reimburse Ziteir's reasonable non-refundable travel costs already incurred.

## 4. DELIVERABLES AND ACCEPTANCE

4.1 **Deliverables.** The deliverables under this SOW are:

(a) Site readiness reports;

(b) a commissioning record for each Drone, signed by the Ziteir t

(c) the configured Platform account;

(d) training materials and course completion certificates; and

(e) an end-of-phase report for each phase summarizing Services performed and open items.

Lakix will either accept the phase in writing or describe in writing any material respect in which the Services for that phase did not conform to this SOW. (a) for Ziteir, Priya N. Calloway, Deployment Program Lead; and

6.3 **Insurance.** Ziteir's insurance under Section 13 of the Agreement applies to the Services, including aviation liability insurance while Ziteir personnel operate the Drones during commissioning, test flights and training.

## 7. FEES AND EXPENSES

|---|---|

| ZX-40 Operator Course | $3,200 per Trainee |
| ZX-40 Field Maintenance Course | $2,400 per technician |
| Season support | $9,500 per month during each Season Support Window |
| Annual refresher course (2026) | $650 per Trainee |
| Additional on-site support (outside Season Support Windows) | $1,450 per technician per day |

7.2 **Expenses.** Lakix will reimburse Ziteir's reasonable, documented travel and lodging expenses for on-site Services at the Georgetown Base and the Easton Base. Reimbursement is subject to Lakix's travel policy as provided to Ziteir in writing. No travel expenses are chargeable for Services at the Dover Base.

7.3 **Invoicing and Payment.** Ziteir will invoice:

(a) Site readiness, commissioning and training fees monthly in arrears;

(b) the Platform configuration fee upon completion of configuration; and

(c) season support fees monthly in advance.

Invoices are payable in accordance with Sections 4.4 and 4.5 of the Agreement.

## 8. TERM AND TERMINATION

8.1 **Term.** This SOW begins on the SOW Effective Date. It continues until the Services for all phases have been completed and accepted, unless terminated earlier under this Section 8 or Section 14 of the Agreement.

8.2 **Termination for Convenience.** Lakix may terminate any phase that has not yet begun by giving at least 30 days' written notice before the start of that phase's Services Window. Lakix will pay for Services performed and non-refundable expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

8.3 **Effect.** Termination of this SOW does not terminate the Agreement or any accepted Purchase Order.

## 9. GOVERNING LAW AND FORUM

9.1 **Governing Law.** This SOW, and all disputes arising out of or relating to the Services, are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

9.2 **Forum.** Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in the Borough of Manhattan, New York, New York, for any action arising out of or relating to this SOW or the Services. Each Party waives any objection to venue in those courts.

## 10. GENERAL

10.1 **Incorporation.** This SOW forms part of the Agreement. Sections 11 (Limitation of Liability), 12 (Confidentiality), 16 (Force Majeure) and 17 (Notices) of the Agreement apply to this SOW.

10.2 **Change Orders.** Any change to the scope, Sites, deliverables or fees under this SOW requires a written change order signed by both Parties' authorized representatives.

10.3 **Counterparts.** This SOW may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature. Each counterpart is an original, and together they form one instrument.

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have executed this SOW as of the SOW Effective Date.
